balance.reason: audioplayers maps setBalance onto AVAudioPlayer.pan, which requires a fully buffered local source. This service plays through AVPlayer so it can stream a URL, and AVPlayer exposes no channel-pan control — AVAudioMix carries volume ramps only. Supporting balance means adding a second, AVAudioPlayer-backed path for local and base64 sources.

on_stream.reason: Flet's own audio_recorder renderer (flet_packages/flet_audio_recorder/lib/src/audio_recorder.dart) emits state_change and nothing else, so there is no upstream streaming behaviour to match.

on_upload.reason: Flet's own audio_recorder renderer emits state_change and nothing else; the recorder never performs an upload, so on_upload has no consumer upstream either.

on_result.reason: Flet's file_picker service reports progress through the upload event and returns picked files as the method-call result rather than pushing a result event; flet_packages/flet/lib/src/services/file_picker.dart triggers only "upload".

android_options.reason: Configures flutter_secure_storage's Android EncryptedSharedPreferences back end (cipher algorithms, biometric enforcement). The Apple renderer stores through the Keychain and has no Android back end to configure.

windows_options.reason: Configures flutter_secure_storage's Windows credential-store back end, which does not exist on Apple platforms.

web_options.reason: Configures flutter_secure_storage's web back end, whose wrapping key lives in browser local storage; a native Apple client has no such back end.
